title_sq: Njesi Komerciale per shitie st Dinamo
description_sq:
Njesi Komerciale per shitie buz ruge
Ofrojme njesi komerciale per shitje tek stadiumi Dinamo
Nje zone me akses te menjehershem me levizjet ne qytet dhe ne unaze
Ndodhet ne kryqezimin e rrugeve me vizibilitet maksimal ne dy krahet e rruges fasade xhami.
Shume e pershtatshme per aktivitete tregtare apo sherbimi, pasi ndodhet ne nje zone me levizshmeri te madhe qytetaresh.
title_en: Commercial unit for sale st Dinamo
description_en: Commercial unit for sale by the street We offer a commercial unit for sale near the Dinamo stadium, an area with immediate access to the city and ring roads. Very suitable for commercial or service activities, as it is located in an area with high mobility of citizens.
